text:
sam: FYI  ran an a11y pass on the Model Performance panel sparklines. Two issues: low contrast between trend line + legend swatches (esp. with high-contrast toggle), and keyboard focus order between legend chips and the chart canvas is inconsistent.

sam: quick repro:
```
1) Console > Models > Open a model > Performance tab
2) Tab into the legend row (sparkline color swatches)
3) Press Right Arrow to move across chips; Shift+Tab goes into chart canvas instead of previous chip
```

zoe: I saw this on macOS with VoiceOver  legend chips are focusable but the chart uses role=\"img\" and gets early focus. VO announces \"chart\", then chip labels aren't associated.

amar: theory: the chart canvas is focusable to allow keyboard zoom/pan, but its tabindex=0 is before the legend in DOM order for visually-stacked layout. For keyboard users we should keep DOM order matching visual order and ensure aria-describedby links chart to legend.

chai: suggestions:
- move legend chips earlier in DOM or visually reorder via CSS grid while keeping logical DOM order
- add aria-describedby on the chart to reference the legend container id
- ensure each legend chip has role=\"button\" and aria-pressed to indicate selection state
- increase contrast: use token --color-sparkline-1: #0ea5a4 (teal-500) instead of current #5eead4 which fails AA on light bg

sam: CSS note for contrast patch:
```css
.legend-chip:focus { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring); }
.sparkline path { stroke: var(--color-sparkline-1); stroke-width: 2px; }
```

zoe: for screen readers, add aria-live updates when selection changes, e.g. \"Selected: Latency (30d)\". Also ensure legend container has aria-label=\"performance metric legend\" so it's exposed to assistive tech.

amar: e2e test update: simulate Tab across legend chips and assert focus order stable; add an axe-core smoke test for the panel in CI. Also add a small VoiceOver/NVDA manual QA step in the issue checklist.

sam: created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/issues/4230 with before/after swatches and VoiceOver notes. tagging for 1.19 work.

chai: low-risk contrast token swap could land in 1.18.2 if we decouple the token change from broader visual updates; otherwise prefer grouping into 1.19 for design review.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy for branch \"fix/sparkline-legend-a11y-4230\" to staging in 12 minutes.

sam: thanks all  I'll attach screenshots, color contrast proof, and a minimal axe report to the PR and open the patch.
